convert_pascal_voc_to_mmdet: convert PASCAL VOC annotations to mmdetection pkl format using devkit path and output directory
convert_pascal_voc_to_coco: convert PASCAL VOC annotations to COCO json format from devkit path with specified output directory

build_voc_annotation_pipeline: build an annotation conversion pipeline processing VOC train val and test splits across multiple years
